title: Chanderi sari
summary: Chanderi cloth is a sheer, light fabric of cotton and silk woven in and around the town of Chanderi in Madhya Pradesh. Its open, airy weave is dotted with small motifs of gold and silver thread, called butis, and the cloth is often finished with a fine border. Held to the light, it is almost transparent.
howToPlay: Pick a thread colour and a pattern shape from the tray.
Touch a square on the cloth to weave that shape there; it is mirrored into the other three corners.
Copy the pattern of butis shown on the card, then press Check.
rules: The design is mirrored left to right and top to bottom, so every shape you place also appears on its partner squares.
A square counts only when its shape and its thread colour both match the pattern you are copying.
Three stars need a nearly perfect copy; you can undo or clear as often as you like.
heritageNote: Chanderi lies in the north of Madhya Pradesh, and its weavers have long made fine cloth for turbans and saris. The cloth is valued for being light enough to wear in hot weather while still shimmering with its small woven motifs.
